scripts.gen:pkg: bun -e "const pkg = require('./package.json'); delete pkg.scripts; delete pkg.devDependencies; pkg.main = './index.js'; pkg.module = './index.js'; pkg.types = './index.d.ts'; pkg.exports = { '.': { 'types': './index.d.ts', 'import': './index.js' } }; Bun.write('./dist/package.json', JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2));"
scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run build:js && bun run build:types && bun run gen:pkg
scripts.release: git checkout -b release-temp && bun run build && git add -f dist && git commit -m "chore: release build" && git subtree split --prefix dist -b release-dist && git push origin release-dist:release --force && git checkout main && git branch -D release-temp release-dist
